description: SHEETS-UI (docs/design/sheets-ui.md): the Assignments tab, written by App.Google.AssignmentSheets and formatted by AppWeb.SheetLayout. Columns with a `field` take their label, format and help from the form schema named in `form` (the same form the app shows); the others are read-only context. `key` is the column's name in App.People.AssignmentSync (row 1, hidden); `copyOf` keeps the exported value hidden so a changed cell is highlighted. `status`: the app writes each row's check or import result there (AppWeb.SheetStatus), coloured by its first sign.
